title: AION 2 Classes: All Eight Roles and Icons
description: Compare AION 2’s eight Global classes, icons, names, and combat roles to choose your first character.
summary: Choose from eight Global classes by the role and combat rhythm you enjoy. Compare tanking, ranged damage, healing, and Chanter support before checking a build.
quickAnswer: Choose Templar for a tank role, Cleric for healing and recovery, or Chanter for melee support. Gladiator, Assassin, Ranger, Sorcerer and Spiritmaster offer different damage playstyles; pick the combat job you enjoy before comparing rankings.

workflow.title: Choose a class by the job you want to do
workflow.caption: Compare the role, range, and combat controls you enjoy.

steps.label: Choose your responsibility
steps.description: Decide whether you want to position enemies, deal damage, recover allies, or switch between support and attacks.

steps.label: Shortlist two classes
steps.description: Compare range and the extra work you enjoy: summons, cast timing, buff coverage, or melee access.

steps.label: Try one concrete task
steps.description: Practice movement and target selection, then keep your main combat and emergency controls reachable.

steps.label: Choose the comfortable loop
steps.description: Use similar encounters and progression. Pick the class you can operate while handling mechanics.
